<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/helium/l2/mobile-reward-shares/daily-totals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves Mobile reward totals bucketed by UTC day (using `end_period`) for a given time range, optionally allowing to filter by hotspot key and reward type. The range between `from` and `to` cannot exceed 366 days. Requires the OracleData feature with aggregate endpoints enabled.

  children={"Request"}
